# Pinyin typed after text already there, written for this project (no third-party text).
# One sample per line: input<TAB>expected<TAB>tag<TAB>context, the context being the text before
# the cursor when the input starts. Each input's reading alone leaves more than one likely text;
# the context settles it, as it would for a reader. Pairs share an input and differ by context.
#   pair       one of two samples with the same input, told apart by their contexts
#   single     the context makes one of several readings the likely one
